segments.name: Complete action
segments.stageGoal: From being unable to read to understanding the message.
segments.mainConflict: Lin needs glasses locked in the box.
characterArcs: Lin accepts help and thanks Chen.
segments.cost: Lin has to ask for help.
segments.audienceReward: A small act of care is received.
segments.carryOut: The greeting is read and the action resolved.

arcs: Lin moves from frustration to gratitude.
setupsPayoffs: Unreadable note becomes readable after obtaining glasses.
coreHighlights: An ordinary gift restores the ability to read.
value.synopsis: Lin takes the key from Chen, unlocks the box, puts on the repaired glasses and reads the birthday note. Lin smiles in thanks.
value.mainResistance: The locked box and unreadable note.

pressure.cannotRetreat: The birthday message matters to Lin.

whyWatch.reason: Discover what is in the locked box and see the message become readable.

hooks.imageOrLine: Lin holds a blurred note beside a locked box.
hooks.question: Can Lin read the message?

setups.payoff: After putting on the glasses, Lin reads the birthday greeting.

value.reversalsNote: No reversal is needed; the gift is an earned resolution, not a hidden identity.
creativeBans: No relatives, third character or second location.
The note is read only after the glasses are worn.
Resolve within this episode, without a sequel.
